fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Chart.js bar charts on the deck and person pages set their y-axis (or x-axis for horizontal bars) `max` value to `round(max_value * 1.3)`. This 30% headroom above the tallest bar was intended to leave space for the datalabel, but it created an unnecessarily large gap between the top of each bar and its label.

## What changed

Reduced the multiplier from `1.3` to `1.1` in two places:

- `decksite/views/deck.py` line 61 — mana cost distribution chart (vertical bars)
- `decksite/views/person.py` line 51 — colour distribution chart (horizontal bars)

The 10% headroom is still enough for Chart.js to render datalabels without clipping while keeping labels visually close to their bars.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `python -m pytest decksite/views/ -x -q` — 9 passed

Fixes #12454
fix.pr_title: Reduce gap between bars and datalabels in charts (#12454)
